pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Riverside's free Basic plan includes 2 one-off hours. Riverside Pro costs $29 a month billed monthly or $24 a month billed annually… Business pricing is custom"

sources.title: Is Riverside Free? Pricing and Free Trial Explained (2026)

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Further self-serve tiers exist ($24–$79/month annually per the sources).

nl.tagline: Podcasts en video-interviews opnemen in studiokwaliteit, ook op afstand
nl.description: Riverside neemt audio en video per deelnemer lokaal op, zodat een internetstoring de opname niet verpest. Daarna bewerk je via transcript, maak je automatisch clips voor social en exporteer je in hoge kwaliteit.
bestFor: Podcasts en interviews met gasten op afstand
notFor: Wie alleen al bestaande audio wil bewerken

en.tagline: Record studio-quality podcasts and video interviews remotely
en.description: Riverside records audio and video locally for each participant, so a bad connection doesn't ruin the recording. You then edit via transcript, auto-create social clips and export in high quality.
bestFor: Podcasts and interviews with remote guests
notFor: People who only need to edit existing audio
limitations: Free plan: 2 one-off hours of recording
